title: Physician Client Accounts: Account Class Qualification Schedule
content:
Physician Client Accounts are held in six account classes. Which class an ordering organization may hold depends on what kind of organization it is and, for most classes, on the client-billed volume it sustains each calendar month. This schedule states, class by class, the entry requirements, the minimum monthly client-billed volume the organization must sustain to keep the class, how often that volume is reviewed against the class, and how many client accounts (locations) one organization may hold.

## Entry requirements by class

| Account class | Organization | Further entry requirements |
|---|---|---|
| Independent Practice Client Account | Physician practice | One location; NPI verified |
| Group Practice Client Account | Physician practice | Minimum monthly client-billed volume of USD 2500.00; NPI verified |
| Multispecialty Medical Group Account | Physician practice | Minimum monthly client-billed volume of USD 10000.00; NPI verified |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Account | Federally qualified health center | HRSA designation; NPI verified |
| Hospital Outreach Reference Account | Hospital laboratory | Minimum monthly client-billed volume of USD 15000.00; CLIA certificate required |
| Occupational Health Employer Account | Employer | Chain-of-custody collection; NPI verification not required |

## Class schedule

| Account class | Minimum monthly client-billed volume to keep the class | Volume review cycle | Client accounts (locations) per organization |
|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Practice Client Account | USD 0.00 (no minimum) | every 6 calendar months | 1 |
| Group Practice Client Account | USD 2500.00 | every 6 calendar months | 5 |
| Multispecialty Medical Group Account | USD 10000.00 | every 6 calendar months | 25 |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Account | USD 0.00 (no minimum) | every 12 calendar months | 15 |
| Hospital Outreach Reference Account | USD 15000.00 | every 6 calendar months | 10 |
| Occupational Health Employer Account | USD 1500.00 | every 12 calendar months | 20 |

## Reading the schedule

- **Minimum monthly client-billed volume** is the value, in US dollars, of tests client-billed to the organization in a calendar month that the organization must sustain to keep its account class. A figure of USD 0.00 means the class sets no minimum.
- **Volume review cycle** is the number of calendar months between reviews of the organization's billed volume against its account class.
- **Client accounts per organization** is the number of client accounts, one per location, that a single organization may hold in the class.

## Illustrations (hypothetical organizations)

- A physician practice with three locations, NPI verified, expecting about USD 4000.00 a month in client-billed tests: the Independent Practice Client Account admits one location only; the expected volume reaches the Group Practice Client Account minimum of USD 2500.00 but not the Multispecialty Medical Group Account minimum of USD 10000.00; the Group Practice class allows up to 5 locations.
- An employer that needs chain-of-custody drug-screen collections: the Occupational Health Employer Account is the only class whose organization type is an employer; it does not require NPI verification and carries a minimum monthly client-billed volume of USD 1500.00.
- A hospital laboratory sending reference work: the Hospital Outreach Reference Account requires a CLIA certificate and a minimum monthly client-billed volume of USD 15000.00, reviewed every 6 calendar months.
